newsitem.title: USA: Arbor Drugs to add 15-20 stores in FY97.
newsitem.headline: Arbor Drugs to add 15-20 stores in FY97.

text.p: Arbor Drugs Inc said Thursday it plans to open 15-20 new stores in fiscal year 1997, which began August 1.

"In addition to being a drugstore industry innovator in pharmacy systems and distribution management, we are very pleased with the high quality sites we have identified for future expansion," chief executive Eugene Applebaum said in a news release. "This confidence in the future of our community health-care niche is expressed in the 15 to 20 new stores planned for fiscal 1997."
Earlier Thursday, the drugstore chain reported net income of $7.1 million, or $0.28 a share for the fourth quarter ended July 31, compared with $5.6 million, or $0.23 a share a year ago.
